detours.why: The College Road houses (50 and 36 College Road, Flanagan House at 4 Quincy Road) have no mapped entrances and are reached from the College Road and Quincy Road sidewalks; Welch and Williams snap to the drive and Hammond Street side behind them, so walks go out to College Road and round.
Burns-Bapst Library (way/29812427) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drive on its west side, so walks from Lower Campus climb the steps and go round the building to it.
St. Thomas More Road lies between them; the walk crosses at the mapped crossing to the east and comes back along the sidewalk, and Southwell Hall has no mapped entrance.

Commonwealth Avenue, a divided road, lies between Thomas More Apartments and the Brighton Campus; the walk goes west to the mapped crossing by St. Thomas More Road and back east along the Brighton side.

The Mods have no mapped paths among them, so the pin (Mod 22) leaves by the service drive on the cluster's south side before turning north or west; Corcoran Commons and Southwell Hall have no mapped entrance, and 2125 Commonwealth Avenue is across Commonwealth Avenue, a divided road, reached by the crossing at St. Thomas More Road.
Corcoran Commons (way/29673727) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the footway on its west side, so the walk from 66 Commonwealth Avenue goes round by the steps west of it.
